On The 4 th Of February, 2026
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 51161 of 2025
 Akash Alias Akku
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Himanshu Tiwari - Advocate for the applicant.
Ms. Geeta Yadav - G.A. for the State.

Shri Kamal Singh Rajput - Advocate for the respondent/
 Order
Learned counsel for the applicant is only pressing for temporary bail (I.A. No.2405/2026) and he prays for withdrawal of regular bail application.
Prayer is allowed.
In view of the above, present M.Cr.C. for regular bail is dismissed as withdrawn as not pressed.
Heard on I.A. No.2405/202 6 which is an application for grant of temporary bail.

2. The applicant has been arrested on 05.05.2024 in connection with Crime No.19/2025 registered at Police Station - Mahila Thana, District Harda (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(N), 376(3), 450, 506 of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, 2012.

entities.text: Police Station - Mahila Thana, District Harda
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
3. It is submitted by learned counsel for applicant that the applicant is NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-JBP:10018 2 MCRC-51161-2025 suffering from Hepatitis B and mental disease.

Therefore, it is prayed that applicant be enlarged on temporary bail for his treatment and hospitalization.
4.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the objector opposed the prayer of the applicant.
5. Learned Government Advocate submitted that health status report of the applicant has been received from the concerning jail and the factum of his illness has been verified.

sentences.text:
6. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, temporary bail application i.e. I.A.
No.2405/2026 is allowed and applicant be released on temporary bail till 04.03.2026.

7. It is directed that the applicant be released on temporary bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court.
8. It is directed that applicant shall surrender immediately on 05.03.2026 before the concerned trial Court.

Counsel for the applicant is also directed that when applicant will surrender before concerned Competent Magistrate, certified copy of the order sheet of the concerned Competent Magistrate regarding his surrender shall be filed by him.
Further, the surrender report of the applicant shall be submitted by the concerned Competent Magistrate to the Registry of this Court for information.

9. It is also directed that if applicant fails to surrender on the said date, the concerned Competent Magistrate shall take appropriate steps for securing NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-JBP:10018 3 MCRC-51161-2025 his arrest.
10. Accordingly, the bail application is disposed off.
Certified copy as per rules.
